newsitem.title: UK: Next says caught short of summer stock.
newsitem.headline: Next says caught short of summer stock.

text.p: Retailer Next Plc said mistakes made during the spring and summer caused a stock shortage which have held back sales since the end of its half year.
"I think the main mistake we made towards the end of the season was that we were caught short of stock," chief executive David Jones told a news conference.

"With the best will in the world you don't budget for a 23 percent increase in turnover," Jones said. Next retail increased sales in the first half by 23 percent. Jones said sales in June and July were well above expectations and Next brought stock forward from August into July leaving it short of stock later.
Jones said it would take another few weeks to get stock back to where the company wanted it to be. "By the end of September stock will be more or less where we want it to be," he said.
He said the decision to hold the summer sale later in July than in previous years contributed to the shortage. "We were caught short of a small number of important lines."
Disappointment at Next's current sales performance knocked its shares, which stood 23.5 pence lower at 576.5 pence by 1246 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
